Berliner Kältehilfe

Berlin, Germany
Checked 2026-08-14

Berliner Kältehilfe provides emergency overnight accommodation, warm meals, and medical help for homeless people in Berlin during the cold season. The service aims to prevent people without shelter from freezing to death.

  • Shelter
  • Food
  • Health
CostFree resource finder.

The service is free of charge for people who have no place of their own and cannot afford accommodation.

AccessOfficial online locator and app
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Berlin, Germany

Check before you go. The cold relief season lasts from October to April. Emergency overnight stays are generally open every evening during this period.

Sharewear Clothing Scheme

Nottingham, United Kingdom
Checked 2026-08-14

Sharewear Clothing Scheme provides free, good quality clothing to people experiencing hardship in Nottingham. The service operates via a referral system, allowing clients to choose clothing for themselves and their families.

The service provides clothing free of charge to those referred.
